_header.title: Unified App Factory gate list
_header.author: Claude Code
_header.status: PROPOSAL - nothing here changes GATES.csv or any master register. Conflicts stay OPEN until Lisa replies.
_header.how_conflicts_work: A gate whose conflict_ids include an OPEN conflict reports WAITS-LISA and is never auto-passed. Lisa's reply flips that conflict's status to RESOLVED (data change only, no code change).

universal_checks.rule: A gate cannot pass while its stage section in THE-DOCUMENT says PENDING (count must be 0)
No row of the 3.7 Obligations ledger due at this gate is OPEN or PART (count must be 0)

conflicts.title: How many gates
conflicts.text_a: GATES.csv: 7 gates (5 Gate-0 variants + G1 + G2)
conflicts.text_b: Framework s2: 12 gates; GATE-LOG header: 9 names; STAGE-TRANSITIONS: 8 transitions
conflicts.impact: No single canonical count; this list uses the 12 plus BASE (13 rows).

conflicts.title: Base 2->3 and Design 4->5 are not among the 12
conflicts.text_b: Framework s2 lists no Base gate; its Stage-4 gate is called Schema
conflicts.impact: Design is treated as an alias of SCHEMA. BASE has no framework status, so it waits.

conflicts.title: RECYCLE verdict at Merit
conflicts.text_a: GATES.csv G1 verdict set: GO / KILL / HOLD / RECYCLE / GO WITH CONDITIONS
conflicts.text_b: Framework PR617: RECYCLE never applies at Merit; Merit has RESHAPE
conflicts.impact: A RECYCLE verdict at MERIT reports WAITS-LISA. G1 also has no RESHAPE.

conflicts.title: Leak / Launch order
conflicts.text_a: Framework s2 lists ... Invest, Leak, Launch, Live
conflicts.text_b: STAGE-TRANSITIONS puts the leak check at 7->8, after Launch 6->7
conflicts.impact: LEAK's position is uncertain, so it waits.

conflicts.title: GATES.csv covers few of the 12
conflicts.text_a: GATES.csv maps to Screen, Slot, and (if G1 is read as Merit) Merit
conflicts.impact: 9 or 10 of the 12 have no GATES.csv row, depending on whether G1 counts as Merit. UNVERIFIED which.

conflicts.title: Who runs G2 / Slot
conflicts.text_a: GATES.csv G2 who_runs_it: UNDECIDED - automatic block vs report only
conflicts.text_b: Framework s2 calls Slot a test that stops the work

conflicts.title: Verdict outside the six-verdict set
conflicts.text_a: GATE-LOG GL008 verdict: 'REFINED TO TEN4 - GO WITH CONDITIONS'
conflicts.text_b: GATE-LOG VERDICTS list: GO, GO WITH CONDITIONS, RESHAPE/REFINE, HOLD, KILL, RECYCLE
conflicts.impact: That literal verdict reports WAITS-LISA at LOCK.

conflicts.title: Slot has no transition in any source (found by this job)
conflicts.text_b: No transition row mentions Slot except Rescue->Slot
conflicts.impact: SLOT is attached to 5->6 as a placeholder (UNVERIFIED) and waits.

conflicts.title: Return placement and automation (found by this job)
conflicts.text_a: Framework lists Return after Live as a test gate
conflicts.text_b: STAGE-TRANSITIONS: Return runs before every next Invest; the test is not yet automated
conflicts.impact: RETURN is not required at any transition yet and cannot auto-pass.

conflicts.title: RESHAPE/REFINE written as one verdict (found by this job)
conflicts.text_b: Framework PR617: RESHAPE at Merit, REFINE at Lock
conflicts.impact: Per-gate verdict sets used (RESHAPE only at MERIT, REFINE only at LOCK). Low impact.
